messages:
olivia: Quick share — ran KV quantization warmup + prefetch bake this morning on chat-13B-v2. Compared FP8-KV, INT8-KV, and KV-unquant (fp16) across cold/warm/taillatencies.

sanjay: Nice. What infra? GPUs / batch config?

olivia: 4x A100 80GB, continuous batching disabled for deterministic tail; batch_size=1 for latency SLO. Prefetch enabled with threshold=64 tokens.

mika: TL;DR numbers?

olivia: Median latencies (ms): fp16-kv 112, int8-kv 98, fp8-kv 92. 95p: fp16 240, int8 210, fp8 190. Memory: fp16-kv 18.9GB, int8-kv 12.3GB, fp8-kv 10.6GB.

ciara: Accuracy/quality deltas on prompt eval set?

olivia: Small eval (500 prompts QA + token-likelihood): int8-kv BLEU-like QA F1 delta -0.6 percentage points vs fp16; fp8-kv delta -1.2pp. For rouge-like, deltas within -0.4pp (int8) and -0.9pp (fp8).

sanjay: Any hallucination patterns?

olivia: Mostly minor truncation at long contexts when fp8 applied to both kv + weights; here we only quantized KV so hallucination delta tiny. Noted 4/500 examples where answer truncated earlier with fp8.

bench-bot: CI snapshot: commit sha abcd1234, run 2026-03-20 10:12Z, bench id kv-prefetch-215

mika: How about cold-start penalty and warmup tokens?

olivia: Cold-start cold tail (first req after idle): +30ms for int8 vs fp16, +45ms for fp8. But with prefix prefetch warmup (64 tokens) we recovered within 2 reqs. Prefetch cost is ~8ms extra per warmup run.

ciara: Deployment considerations?

sanjay: If SLA is tight, int8-kv seems sweet spot — good mem savings, small quality hit. FP8-kv gives max density but more tail risk. Also add rollback policy for A/B.

olivia: Added an experiment PR with configs and repro steps: 
```
# run bench
python infra/bench/kv_quant_bake.py --model chat-13b-v2 --kv-quant int8 --prefetch 64 --runs 1000
```

mika: Can you drop the perf traces to /mnt/bench/kv/2150001234?

olivia: Done. upload link: s3://redwood-bench/kv/2150001234 :thumbsup:

sanjay: Great. Next: run same on 30B and gated fp8-only-KV+weights trial next week.

olivia: Will schedule. Thanks all.
